ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; the visible ventral surface is comprised of approximately 98% low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels restricted to the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid low-intensity black field across both lobes; high-contrast irregular geometric clusters located at the extreme left and right distal coordinates.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire span; multiple high-amplitude notches and peaks, particularly a significant indentation on the inner-right lobe near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep from the median notch extending to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized exclusively at the left and right fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch; secondary irregular indentations along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated high-intensity white focal point (small spot) located in the mid-region of the left lobe surface.
